stories.title: I built the app. Would people use it every month?
stories.lede: AI has made it possible to take an idea and build software other people can actually use.

in_book.note: Himanshu Kumar got a working app into testers' hands; his open question was whether they would come back next month, at payday. Shipped is a step; coming back is the outcome. Clark's own story for this chapter is still needed.
The first outside guest story to land: Himanshu Kumar's, published under his own name.
